user.title: Set up WeHeat OpenTherm
user.description: Select the sensors and optional services for supply temperature calculation.

data_description.room_temp_sensor: Sensor measuring the current room temperature.
data_description.weather_entity: Used for wind chill and sun corrections.
data_description.price_sensor: EPEX Spot, Tibber or similar; used for price correction.
data_description.setpoint_entity: Optional: input_number bridge for ESPHome. Leave empty when ESPHome reads sensor.weheat_opentherm_aanvoersetpoint directly.

init.title: Temperature settings
init.description: Adjust temperature limits and correction factors.

data_description.target_temp: Target temperature for room compensation calculation.
data_description.t_min: The calculated setpoint will never go below this value.
data_description.t_max: The calculated setpoint will never exceed this value.
data_description.compensation_factor: Higher value = stronger reaction to temperature deviation (default 2.0).
data_description.forecast_hours: Hours ahead to evaluate wind chill and sun (1–6 hours).
data_description.max_price_correction: Maximum correction in °C due to energy prices.

curve.title: Heating curve configuration
curve.description: Define 5 (outdoor temperature → supply temperature) pairs. Points are automatically sorted by outdoor temperature.
